rootCause: The service-authenticated journal worker synchronously joined creation of both unbound native children before sending workerAuthenticatedFrame. The service-to-worker bootstrap and subsequent independent agent authentication could not overlap that construction. A very young candidate can therefore expose child startup on the entry path.
limitation: The collected nativePair readiness span includes loading and authentication and does not isolate CreateProcess time. This serial dependency is a proven contributor, not proof that it explains all 176.742ms.
change: Start exactly one owned asynchronous native-pair constructor only after the existing service permit. Continue existing service/bootstrap authentication concurrently. Join the exact constructor before any child binding/handle transfer, and join it unconditionally before final retirement or pin disposal.
